name: v0.5.0
body:
Waywallen is built with [Lito](https://github.com/litocpp/lito) (Please star it).

### Added

- Smart playlists automatically select wallpapers using filter rules, including library inclusion and exclusion.
- Libraries have editable names and can be hidden from the wallpaper page.
- Automatic sizing follows display and canvas layouts.
- Lock-screen displays have a dedicated role and remain independent of global desktop pause.
- Automatic playback rules can react to battery power. #345 by @MR-kartoshki
- Wallpaper sources can provide author avatars in the detail panel. #343 by @wehrwolfmann

### Improved

- Library directory changes trigger automatic rescanning. #325 by @wehrwolfmann
- Filter rules use numeric steppers and compact text editors.
- Flip controls wrap on narrow panels. #330 by @wehrwolfmann
- The About page shows the daemon version when it differs from the UI version. #327 by @wehrwolfmann
- Packagers can disable update checks at build time. #328 by @wehrwolfmann
- German translations are available. #319 by @wehrwolfmann
- Russian translations are updated. #320 by @wehrwolfmann

### Fixed

- Video renderers advertise even dimensions for NV12 buffers. #332 by @MR-kartoshki
- Wayfire is recognized as a layer-shell display backend. #337 by @MR-kartoshki
- The tray language follows UI language changes. #335 by @MR-kartoshki
- Web wallpaper actions open the correct resource directory. #333 by @MR-kartoshki
- Russian settings labels use clearer wording. #323 by @wehrwolfmann

name: v0.4.4
body:
Waywallen is built with [Lito](https://github.com/litocpp/lito) (Please star it).

### Added

- Automatic playback rules support window exclusions by application ID or title, with wildcard matching.
- Wallpapers can be flipped horizontally, vertically, or both.
- Wallpapers can be hidden from the library and managed from the playlist sheet. #300 by @barrence01
- Optional update checks show a notification badge in the sidebar. #302 by @wehrwolfmann

### Improved

- Thumbnails share animated playback and support configurable decoded-image caching.
- Display controls stay open when switching between displays and canvases.
- Detail actions fold to fit compact layouts.
- Status page labels are translated. #303 by @wehrwolfmann
- Russian translations are updated. #296 by @wehrwolfmann
- The daemon restart button has been removed.

### Fixed

- Pointer leave events are forwarded correctly across shared outputs. #293 by @LostAttractor
- Window size and maximized state are restored correctly, and detail thumbnails reserve space while loading.
- Closed UI processes are reaped instead of remaining as zombie processes.
- QML singleton registration and property bindings work with Qt 6.12.
- AppImage FFmpeg builds include the image demuxers and parsers required for thumbnails.

name: v0.4.3

name: v0.4.1
body:
Waywallen is built with [Lito](https://github.com/litocpp/lito) (Please star it).

### Improved

- Remote MPRIS artwork is cached locally before being sent to wallpaper renderers. #283 by @CatSema

### Fixed

- Embedded and oversized MPRIS artwork no longer exceeds renderer IPC limits. #282 by @barrence01
- The mouse parallax setting stays in the built-in property section. #274 by @ales-drnz
- The UI no longer fails to load because of stale QML Material cache metadata.

name: v0.4.0
body:
Waywallen is built with [Lito](https://github.com/litocpp/lito) (Please star it).

### Added

- Wallpaper transitions with configurable effects, duration and direction. #264 by @OctaNebula
- A sidebar carousel shows currently playing wallpapers.
- Displays can pause independently while sharing a renderer.
- Automatic playback actions support current-display and all-display scopes.

### Improved

- Display controls use compact status tags.
- Video playback speed can be adjusted in one-percent steps. #273 by @ales-drnz
- Library tags and content ratings use source-provided labels. #257 by @wehrwolfmann
- Plugins can provide wallpaper type labels. #266 by @wehrwolfmann
- The UI checks daemon capabilities instead of version strings. #256 by @wehrwolfmann

### Fixed

- Playlist status updates after a wallpaper activation fails. #258 by @wehrwolfmann
- Incompatible plugin entry versions are reported clearly. #260 by @wehrwolfmann
- The display demo supports timeline-only renderers. #265 by @wehrwolfmann
- Content bindings distinguish wallpaper changes from presentation configuration updates.

name: v0.3.9
body:
Waywallen is built by [Lito](https://github.com/litocpp/lito) (Please star it).

### Improved

- Wallhaven detail tags use the localized labels declared by the source.
- Tray menu labels can be translated. #240 by @wehrwolfmann
- Russian translations use clearer wording. #245 by @wehrwolfmann
- Native dependencies use the current Lito declaration model.

### Fixed

- Plugin updates restart affected renderers.
- Automatic playback resume is debounced to avoid repeated restarts.
- Video wallpapers preserve their playback position across pause and fade transitions.
- Plugin setting labels no longer show unresolved translation keys. #211 by @wehrwolfmann

name: v0.3.6

name: v0.3.5
body:
### Added
- Canvases with compose wallpapers across multiple outputs.
- Displays can request a fresh frame from active renderers.
- Open remote link in Wallpaper details page.
### Fixes
- Automatic display backends are selected correctly.
- Renderer init signal times out.
- Qt strings fall back to the qtbase catalog. #200 by @wehrwolfmann
### Improved
- Remote filters show compact choices inline.
- Search input uses 1s debounce.
- GPU names include resolved vendor and device names.
- Russian translations are refreshed. #199 by @wehrwolfmann

name: v0.3.4
body:
### Added
- Synchronized playlists can share playback across multiple displays. #185 by @barrence01
- Wallhaven purity filtering.
- The changelog opens automatically after an update.
- Playlists can be created directly from the playlist sheet.
### Fixes
- Manual wallpaper changes stop playlist playback only on affected displays.
- Shared playlists restore reliably after restarts, display hotplug, and per-display changes.
- Renderer startup reports early process exits without waiting for a timeout.
- MPRIS updates follow renderer runtime subscriptions.
- BBCode links are converted correctly.
- Empty outlined text fields no longer leave a placeholder gap in the border.
- Bridge protocol decoding rejects oversized collections. #190 by @15daksh-2003
### Improved
- Retained renderer states and replay debouncing reduce repeated process restarts.
- FFmpeg 9 runtime loading support.
- Text fields and combo boxes use compact sizing.
- Vulkan header dependency detection and diagnostics. #189 by @15daksh-2003

name: v0.3.3
body:
### Fixes
- VAAPI hardware decoding no longer stalls between frames when looped video restarts.
- Vulkan hardware decoding no longer intermittently displays stale frames.

name: v0.3.2
body:
### Added
- Playback speed controls for video wallpapers. #167
- An option to hide the tray icon without restarting. #149 by @OctaNebula
- Source plugin support apply with user property defaults.
- In-app changelog.
- Renderer status tags for hwdec status.
### Fixes
- Displays refresh frame after layout changes.
- Renderer clear colors are preserved when display links are created.
- Vulkan bridge buffers support sampled display imports.
- Renderer spawn version mismatches fail immediately.
### Improved
- Reduce VAAPI video playback latency.
- Update guidance for incompatible displays.

name: v0.3.1
body:
- Bump up spawn version.

name: v0.3.0
body:
### Added
- Global mute and pause status controls.
- Daemon-controlled pause effects and pointer forwarding controls.
- Runtime UI language switching and Chinese translations.
- Russian UI translations. #175 by @wehrwolfmann
- Russian desktop entry and AppStream translations. #176 by @wehrwolfmann
- Custom accent color support.
- Wallhaven wallpaper titles now include the uploader. #171 by @wehrwolfmann
### Fixes
- Display frame release handling and protocol v8 contracts.
- PulseAudio error buffers compile on aarch64.
- Popup creation, parenting, and deferred opening.
### Improved
- Audio capture sends PCM windows over renderer IPC.
- Display protocol connection errors and runtime health are reported in the UI.
- Tooltips, layouts, and navigation icons.
- Desktop integration documentation for niri and Wayfire. #165 by @wehrwolfmann
- Russian documentation. #177 by @CatSema

name: v0.2.6
body:
### Added
- Remote source account sessions with QR sign-in, subscription controls, and discovery filters. #142 by @WorkingRobot
- Global renderer audio controls, including capture toggles.
- Automatic muting while other audio is playing.
- Theme preference.
- Persistent network image cache.
### Fixes
- source: surface scan failures instead of reporting success. #153 by @ales-drnz
- Renderer random freeze due to wrong mpmc channel.
- Renderer buffers are no longer reused before every display releases them.
- Displays remain bound to the exact buffer publication during wallpaper switches.
- Pointer coordinates are mapped correctly on rotated displays.
- Renderer resume retries now use backoff.
### Improved
- Discover views preserve their state, avoid redundant reloads, and show clearer item details.
- Renderer startup failures provide more useful diagnostics.
- Audio capture and device lifetime management are more reliable.

name: v0.2.5
body:
### Added
- Flatpak autostart support through the desktop portal.
- System notifications for available plugin updates.
- Text user properties.
- An option to allow duplicate renderer instances when displays share a wallpaper.
### Fixes
- Discover pagination now continues when the initial view already reaches the end of the loaded list.
- Opening wallpaper folders from Flatpak now uses the desktop portal.
- Content-rating filters no longer hide wallpapers without a rating.
### Improved
- Wallpaper search now matches external IDs.
- The interface follows the system accent color.

name: v0.2.4
body:
### Added
- Plugin update checks with background scheduling, manual refresh, and progress reporting.
- Plugin update installation flow with update actions and registry refresh after install.
- Per-wallpaper audio enable/disable support for the video renderer.
### Fixes
- Plugin scan ownership now preserves system and user roots during scanning.
- Plugin install completion is no longer blocked by renderer restart handling.
- Plugin filters refresh supported types after installing new renderers.
- Wallpaper property editing keeps the selected wallpaper stable during quick switches.
- Looped video decoder frame handling.
- Auto-detected source folders are narrowed.
### Improved
- Plugin page update tags and actions.
- Discover and wallpaper view tweak state are stored separately.
- DBus menu mute state is persisted in settings.

name: v0.2.3
body:
### Note
From this version, you need to manually download [open-wallpaper-engine](https://github.com/waywallen/open-wallpaper-engine/releases) plugin zip and install it in plugins page.  

### Added
- Discover filters and wallpaper detail controls.
- MPRIS media event forwarding.
- Network cache.
- User plugin management with inactive plugin warnings.
- Hot plugin install, overwrite, and install preview support.
- Wallpaper item removal for sources that support deletion.
- Settings reset action.
- Home path expansion when adding source libraries.
### Fixes
- Discover and wallpaper detail tag/type display.
- Last-modified sorting now falls back to create_at.
- WebSocket protobuf requests no longer block each other.
- Filter dialog creation and parenting errors.
- Status components are sorted alphabetically.
- Display page spacing and responsive headers.
### Security
- Bind WebSocket control plane to localhost by @RedOrkGreenRox in #116.

name: v0.2.2

- Cosmic support.
- Custom resolution.
### Fixes
- Layershell display rotation.
- Web wallpaper init on nvidia card.
require to set `shared_texture_enabled` OFF in web renderer setting.
- Image frames replay after relinking displays to an existing image renderer.
- Renderer texture size reporting on the displays page.
- Wallpapers loading component when filtered.
